discovery.title: Webb spots a rare ring-shaped galaxy from the early universe
discovery.summary: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope identified a rare ring galaxy dating to roughly two billion years after the Big Bang, with a likely colliding galaxy nearby.
discovery.why_it_matters: The unexpected shape offers a glimpse of how collisions can reshape galaxies, including in the universe’s early eras.
